rules.content:
title: AI-Generated Domain Lexical Pattern Detection
status: experimental
description: Detects domain registrations exhibiting lexical patterns consistent with AI-generated names: natural-language-like domain names that are grammatically plausible but not established brands, unusual TLD
logsource:
    product: dns_intelligence
    service: zone_file_diff
detection:
    selection:
        event_type: "new_domain_registration"
        lexical_nlp_score|gte: 0.75
        dga_entropy_score|lte: 3.5
        domain_word_count|gte: 2
    aggregation:
        count|gte: 10
        groupby: "registrar_id"
        timeframe: "24h"
    condition: selection and aggregation
level: medium
rules.title: DL-0098: AI-Generated Domain Lexical Pattern Detection (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: Bulk Let's Encrypt Certificate Issuance Clustering
status: experimental
description: Detects clusters of Let's Encrypt certificate issuances for domains sharing nameserver or registrar characteristics within a short time window. RDGA and AI-generated campaigns frequently provision cer
logsource:
    product: dns_intelligence
    service: ct_log
detection:
    selection:
        event_type: "certificate_issuance"
        issuer_org: "Let's Encrypt"
        registration_to_cert_delta|lte: "24h"
    aggregation:
        count|gte: 15
        groupby: "nameserver_cluster"
        timeframe: "6h"
    condition: selection and aggregation
level: high
rules.title: DL-0099: Bulk Let's Encrypt Certificate Issuance Clustering (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: Zone File Daily Diff Anomaly Detection
status: experimental
description: Detects anomalous patterns in daily zone file diffs: unusual volume of new registrations in a single TLD, concentration of registrations at specific registrars, or patterns suggesting algorithmic gene
logsource:
    product: dns_intelligence
    service: zone_file_diff
detection:
    selection:
        event_type: "zone_file_new_entry"
        registration_volume_zscore|gte: 3.0
    aggregation:
        count|gte: 50
        groupby: "registrar_id, tld"
        timeframe: "24h"
    condition: selection and aggregation
level: high
rules.title: DL-0100: Zone File Daily Diff Anomaly Detection (Sigma)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for AI-Generated Content Scoring")`
`comment("Requires Splunk DSDL with NLP model deployed")`
index=email sourcetype=email:content
| apply stylometric_phishing_model
| where stylometric_score > 0.75
| where urgency_marker_count > 3 OR authority_indicator_count > 2
| table _time, sender, recipient, subject, stylometric_score,
        imperative_verb_ratio, urgency_marker_count, authority_indicator_count
rules.title: DL-0139: AI-Generated Phishing Content Stylometric Detection (SPLUNK)
